verdict.rationale: Phoenix is an LLM tracing and observability product, so capturing multimodal payloads in traces is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack covers model calls, retrieval, tool use, token usage and retrieved documents in traces. Nothing in it mentions capturing or rendering images, audio or files within spans.

support.subject: As a developer, I can capture multimodal payloads (images, audio, files) inside my traces
